title: xXCAMPXx
description: Start an adventure-packed journey with friends—catch Cobblemon, explore new biomes, dungeons, gear up with epic mods, battle, build, and chill around the campfire(sing a campfire song) with a world to explore.
body:
A modpack inspired for a Better of all Minecraft, built for players who love Minecraft, exploration, and a bit of chaos with friends. At its heart is Cobblemon, but it goes far beyond that—featuring The Aether, Better Combat, Artifacts, Immersive Aircraft, tons of new armor and tools, custom dimensions, world enhancements, and hundreds of quality-of-life mods that make vanilla feel empty once you’ve tried it. Whether you're soaring across biomes, hunting legendaries, delving through new dimensions, or just setting up the perfect campsite with friends, there's always something to discover. Thanks to the Essential mod, you can easily host worlds and play together without needing a server—perfect for casual hangs or full SMP adventures. Tweak your settings, make it your world, and dive into the experience.

Hope you enjoy the journey Camper.
